name: Can all drywall textures be perfectly matched?

mainEntity.name: Can all drywall textures be perfectly matched?

acceptedAnswer.text: While professionals strive for an exact match, achieving 100% perfection can be challenging, especially with older, hand-applied, or very unique textures. Factors like the age of the original texture, paint layers, and environmental conditions can influence the final result. However, a skilled contractor can achieve a blend that is visually indistinguishable to the casual observer. In some cases, blending the repair into a larger area may be suggested for the best result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Achieving a 100% perfect match is challenging, especially with old or unique textures, but skilled contractors can achieve a visually indistinguishable blend.
